contributionsIntro: A selection of significant contributions showcasing SAIL lab's impact on research, education, and professional development in software and AI engineering.

groups.title: Books
groups.description: Books, handbooks, textbooks, and educational materials.

contributions.title: Handbook on Teaching Empirical Software Engineering
contributions.description: This handbook exploits the profound experience and expertise of well-established scholars in the empirical software engineering community to provide guidance and support in teaching various research methods and fundamental concepts.

contributions.title: Introdução à Estatística para Ciência de Dados
contributions.description: In an increasingly data-driven world, the ability to understand and apply statistical concepts in data science is becoming increasingly essential for making strategic decisions that can have a crucial impact on business. Professionals in the field are deepening their knowledge of applied statistics to develop a set of skills and tools to effectively handle the uncertainty underlying these decisions. Through the application of statistical methods, data scientists have the ability to translate data into valuable insights, transforming the complex realm of uncertainty into a clear and informed field of action. While Statistics provides the methodological rigor and foundation for reliable inferences, Data Science expands the possibilities with advanced computational techniques and complex models capable of handling the volume, velocity, and complexity of modern data. Together, these disciplines enable the resolution of highly complex problems.

contributions.title: Engenharia de Software para Ciência de Dados
contributions.description: Recent advances in the field of Data Science—particularly in Machine Learning—have made new software solutions viable and practically relevant, solutions that can learn from data and make intelligent predictions. However, for these systems to succeed, they must be built in accordance with best practices in Software Engineering to truly meet customer needs. This book aims to consolidate the field of Software Engineering for Data Science and empower professionals interested in or working in Data Science to build Machine Learning-based systems by demonstrating how to build these systems end-to-end, adapting and applying best practices to this context.

groups.title: Frameworks, Standards & Technologies
groups.description: Methods, frameworks, standards, maturity models, best practices, software/AI tools, patents, and platforms.

contributions.title: POLARIS: A Framework to Guide the Development of Trustworthy AI Systems.
contributions.description: POLARIS, the framework we designed to fill the gaps highlighted in the review of the state of the practice and to provide AI practitioners with actionable guidelines specific to each phase of the SDLC.

contributions.title: DIP-AI: A Discovery Framework for AI Innovation Projects.
contributions.description: DIP-AI, an approach developed to identify and prioritize key problems to be addressed in artificial intelligence innovation projects.

groups.title: Evidence & Knowledge Resources
groups.description: Surveys and evidence syntheses, including systematic reviews, mapping studies, and multivocal reviews.

contributions.title: Constructive Patterns for Human-Centered Tech Hiring
contributions.description: This study addressed the following research question: What constructive patterns shape positive experiences for novice software engineers in online recruitment and selection processes?

contributions.title: A Quasi-Experimental Evaluation of Coaching to Mitigate the Impostor Phenomenon in Early-Career Software Engineers
contributions.description: Comprehensive systematic review analyzing current practices, challenges, and opportunities in AI engineering across industry sectors.

contributions.title: A Multivocal Literature Review on the Benefits and Limitations of Industry-Leading AutoML Tools
contributions.description: The study employed comprehensive and transparent search strategies and qualitative thematic analysis procedures, revealing 18 reported benefits and 25 limitations.
